tree: Plans, billing, credits, and free access.

items.question: Which plan should I pick?
items.answer: Start free, then pick the plan that matches your concurrency and model needs. Enterprise terms on request.

items.question: Why are session counts approximate?
items.answer: Number of sessions can vary depending on task complexity and models used.

items.question: How does inference billing work?
items.answer: Inference is billed per model and per million input and output tokens. Rates vary by model and may change over time. Refer to our terms of use for current details.

items.question: Do you offer a free tier?
items.answer: After registering on H Platform, every user is assigned to the free tier, which provides rate-limited access to Holo3.1 35B-A3B. Holo4 models require a paid tier. If you need a higher rate limit, add credits to move to a paid tier.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: Per our terms of use, we reserve the right to expire unused credits one year after purchase.

items.question: I can't see my credits. What should I do?
items.answer: Payment can take a few minutes to process, please allow up to 15 minutes. If your credits still do not appear, confirm that you have been charged and have received a payment receipt or invoice. If you have not been charged, your card may have been rejected, try again with another one. If you can confirm you have been charged and still do not see credits, contact us at support@hcompany.ai with your purchase so we can investigate.

items.question: What is the refund policy?
items.answer: According to our terms of use, credits are not refundable by default. Depending on your profile and region, refund obligations may apply. Please check our terms of use to learn more.

items.question: Is HoloTab free?
items.answer: HoloTab is free and available on the Chrome Web Store, with no signup required.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: Reach out to us at support@hcompany.ai specifying the nature of your request.
